(CIK 0001399247) suspended its own reporting by Form 15-15D in 2011; the Swinfords resigned 2015-12-31 leaving the CFO sole officer; the filer stopped filing in 2016 'Due to a lack of financial resources', the last periodic filing the 10-Q to 2015-09-30; the 10-K names National Oilwell Varco, Baker Hughes and Weatherford as filing rivals, Thru Tubing Solutions (private) and Smith International (bought by Schlumberger 2010) flagged
runs.box: TOO HARD (NATURE) AT Q1; integrity facts recorded, not judged
runs.entry: Price: **no public quote** (Expert Market; an aggregator page, Seeking Alpha, flagged and not used, showed "$0.0002-0.04" as of 2026-01-09). Shares: 15,632,425 at 2015-11-14 (cover of the last 10-Q, read by hand; `tools/run.py` and `Screens/cover_shares.py` both failed on the ticker map); today's count unknown. Sovereign **5.43%** (US Treasury 30-year par yield, 2026-10-15). Filings read: 10-K FY2014, 0001019687-15-001138; the three 2015 10-Qs, the last 0001019687-15-004085; 8-Ks 0001019687-16-004754 and 0001019687-16-005486; the subsidiary's 15-15D 0001432093-11-000122. Primary documents after 2015 searched: EDGAR (both CIKs, nothing after 2016-03-16), the company's own website (live, pages edited to 2026-06, no investor page, no financial statement, no share count), OTC Markets' issuer disclosure service (down for maintenance on four tries, about 06:49 to 06:52 EDT, not read), a web search (nothing). The brief departed in three stated places: the analyst derived the lines of evidence from the FY2014 10-K's Items 1, 1A and 7; competitors from the 10-K's own list; a paragraph on primary documents after 2015. **Q1 TOO HARD (NATURE)**: the business's present and ten-year economics cannot be known from any document available to an owner, important and unknowable; the NATURE label for a filer that has stopped filing confessed as a CONVENTION of the run, with a re-look condition (audited annual statements filed with the SEC or posted through OTC Markets, also a CONVENTION of the run) in place of a research pass. Q2 to Q12 not reached. **Integrity facts recorded, not judged:** a two-man board of father and son, neither independent, approving its own bonuses; a $3.75M note issued to the chairman in 2015 for patents the company's earlier reports had treated as its own, the earlier agreements said to have been "entered into error"; the two officers sued the company on that note in 2015 and shareholders including the 81.7% holder intervened alleging "fraud and a breach of fiduciary duty", outcome not on the public record; both officers resigned 2015-12-31 and the company stopped filing. Facts beneath the stop: revenue $5.5M to $6.9M 2011 to 2014, third-quarter 2015 revenue down 79% and gross margin (17%) with "an increase in competitive pricing"; customers also competitors; owner cash negative in three of four filed years, the business funded by stock sales and notes; $5.39M of notes against $676K of cash at 2015-09-30, $3.8M due 2018, payment unknown. COMPUTATION on the filed record only (four filed years, FY2011 to FY2014, the sign-changing series taken as the no-growth case alone): value about **$-1.59** a share all-equity ($-1.33 equity-only), fair about **$-1.00 all-equity** ($-0.72 equity-only), against no public quote; not armed, the box being TOO HARD at Q1. Contamination declared by the analyst: the session-start commit subjects (the NOA run and fold) and the operator's memory index, none naming CTBG, not used; no blind-listed file opened, listed or searched. Commits 0d3c095e, 467c8614, two. Position note filled at the fold: not held (`PORTFOLIO.md` carries no line for CTBG). Citations: the analyst's `check_ids.py` PASS; the dispatcher's `dispatcher_cite_check.py` 24 bold ids, no phantom, no E-id, one slip: at **[M1994-077]** the run quotes "what the future stream will look like" where the row reads "what that future stream will look like" (one word; recorded here, the run file not edited); two other flags were the framework's own wording and an 8-K quotation, not slips. No tracked research file over 200 KB. check_framework PASS. **For the operator:** the analyst's gaps: (1) no stated box for a company that has stopped publishing accounts (WORK promises reading will cure it, NATURE is defined by an industry; the analyst proposes a dark-filer rule, TOO HARD (NATURE) re-looked on a new audited statement); (2) Q7's range convention assumes a five-year window, here four filed years; (3) the template does not say what to report when no public quote exists. Could not get: OTC Markets' disclosure service (read it first on any re-look), any proxy (none filed), anything after 2015 (the lawsuit, the debt, the share count, the management).
runs.narr: Q1 TOO HARD (NATURE): a dark filer, no account of the business since the 10-Q to 2015-09-30, the company having stopped filing in 2016 for lack of resources; its website live with no financial page; the NATURE label and a re-look on a new audited statement confessed as CONVENTIONS of the run. Integrity facts recorded, not judged: a father-and-son board approving its own bonuses, a $3.75M note to the chairman for patents earlier treated as the company's, the officers' suit on that note met by a shareholder fraud claim, both officers gone at 2015 year end. COMPUTATION on the filed record: value about $-1.59 a share all-equity, fair about $-1.00 all-equity ($-0.72 equity-only), no public quote (Expert Market); not armed. Framework gaps for the operator: no rule for a filer that has gone dark; Q7 with fewer than five filed years; no reporting line for a name without a quote. One citation slip at M1994-077 (the for that).
